birth.conversion_note: Suetonius (Aug. 5) and Velleius Paterculus give 23 September; Cassius Dio gives 22 September. Scholarly consensus favors 23 September.

death.conversion_note: died at approximately 3pm; last words per Suetonius (Aug. 99): "Acta est fabula, plaudite"

short_description_en: First Roman princeps (27 BCE–14 CE), rose from Caesar's testamentary heir through the Second Triumvirate and civil war to establish the Principate—a system of one-man rule presented in republican forms. His constitutional powers, military patronage, and personal auctoritas created the template for imperial succession.
short_description_zh: 罗马第一位元首（princeps，前27年–14年在位），从凯撒遗嘱继承人崛起，经后三头同盟与内战，建立以共和形式包装的个人统治体系——元首制（Principate）。其宪政权力、军事庇护与个人威望为帝国继承奠定了基础。
